# Version 4.151.0
> **First Skia M151 release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia milestone m151 and ports more color math to managed C#. Continues the v4 performance push by moving SKColor/SKColorF and premultiply conversions into managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries, and fixes a native resource leak in encoded image decoding.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone m151, plus several follow-up chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed a native resource leak decoding images** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource on every call. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Restored CPU raster shader behaviour** — Re-enables SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **More color math ported to managed C#** — SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run as managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, reducing P/Invoke overhead. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Reduced allocations in text shaping paths** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, and per-call char[4] allocations were removed from HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse; SKShaper glyph results are now read via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **New WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM builds, and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Removes a per-call char[4] allocation in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for the HarfBuzz binding.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData native resource leak, restored the CPU raster shader regression, and added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries ahead of the stable release.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Ported SKColor/SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply math to managed C#, removed several hot-path allocations in HarfBuzzSharp and SKFourByteTag, and added the cross-backend golden-image test harness.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)
